blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Filipino social entrepreneur and agriculturist Cherrie Atilano started her Eisenhower Fellowship in Philadelphia on Oct. 5, bringing the aspirations of Filipino farmers into an international exchange on leadership, innovation and sustainable development.
